title: Filling a grid column by column
summary: grid-auto-flow: column fills each column top to bottom before moving right, the reverse of the default.
explanation: By default auto-placement fills rows left to right. With grid-auto-flow: column the placement cursor runs down a column first, then moves right to the next one.
This needs a fixed number of rows, set with grid-template-rows. Without it the grid creates rows as needed, and the items all land in a single column that runs off the bottom.
tryThis: Change grid-template-rows to repeat(4, 40px): each column now holds four items before it wraps to the next.
Change grid-auto-flow back to row: the same items fill left to right instead.
Remove grid-template-rows and watch every item stack in one long column.
